note: R01 release manifest. Only evidence == PASS may switch a flag on; NOT_RUN/FAIL/BLOCKED keep the feature disabled. Scope is fixture-verified, NOT production-validated: no cloud, no TTS model, no rights-cleared corpus, no browser long-task/heap measurement.

features.summary: Upgrade head from an empty data root reaches revision 0018 with every ORM table present and integrity_check=ok.
A 0016 data root with project/chapter/source/translation/artifact rows upgrades to head with identical row counts; 0017/0018 tables arrive empty and the jobs kind whitelist is rebuilt correctly.

A migration that raises mid-way leaves the revision at 0018, keeps the rows intact and is reported as MIGRATION_INCOMPLETE by the preflight/status check; the honest SQLite non-transactional-DDL limitation is recorded.

Backup at 0016, upgrade to head, restore into a new data root: manifest sha256/byte_size re-verify, integrity ok, logical content digest and row counts identical to pre-upgrade, artifacts restored with matching sha256, post-upgrade rows absent.

After the upgrade the real read routes (/api/projects, /api/projects/{id}, chapters page, chapter translation) serve pre-upgrade data; no legacy compatibility route needed to be preserved (grep evidence in the release gate).

Feature flags read docs/validation/release-manifest.json and refuse to switch on any feature whose evidence is not PASS (FEATURE_FLAG_EVIDENCE_NOT_PASS), including when the manifest is missing or malformed.
13 of 14 G-PERF offline fixtures report overallStatus PASS in docs/validation/perf-*.json (fake providers, temporary data root, zero cloud calls).

C2K editor: 'no long task >50ms while typing' needs a real browser PerformanceObserver trace on the 2000-segment fixture; the offline harness has no render engine. Kept NOT_RUN, never inferred from reducer numbers.
SSE 30-minute session and post-GC heap at minute 30: the measured session was cut to 90.1s (plan asks 1800s). Not inferred from the shortened run.
Cloud quality mode: zero provider profiles, zero cloud consents, zero budget authorizations, zero usage ledger rows and no rate cards - no live invocation evidence exists.
VieNeu TTS: no model files on disk, no voice preset rows, no synthesized audio, and no listening review. Fake audio fixtures prove plumbing only.
Rights-cleared corpus and blind bilingual review: rights_evidence is empty, crawled sources carry license=null, and there is no reviewer.
Real FFmpeg mastering: no real FFmpeg run was executed for this release; audio fixtures use the fake processor.
Optional vector index (X06): not part of Phase 1 dependencies and no embedding/retrieval benchmark was run.
Automatic translation approval skips human review; no acceptance evidence exists, so it stays off.
Bypassing the rights gate on public export would violate F03; it must stay off regardless of evidence.
